articles.summary: Mametja Moshe mntungwa Fri, 11/06/2026 - 08:14 Independent non-executive director BCom Hons (Accounting); BCom Hons (Management Accounting); CA(SA); MBA South African Born 1980 Appointed to the Board in 2026 Member of the Audit Committee Ms Mametja Moshe is a Chartered Accountant (SA) and the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Moshe Capital, a South African advisory and investment firm. She has more than 23 years’ experience across corporate finance, equity and debt capital markets, accounting, auditing, corporate tax, strategy and investment. Her career includes investment banking and advisory experience with Morgan Stanley and UBS AG, as well as auditing and corporate tax experience with KPMG. Her sector experience spans mining, financial services, telecommunications, manufacturing, agriculture and transport. Ms Moshe currently serves on the boards of Impala Platinum Holdings Limited and Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited. Company Name Sasol Limited
articles.title: Mametja Moshe

articles.summary: Johannesburg, South Africa - Sasol is expanding access to its premium diesel offering with the rollout of Sasol Turbodiesel ULS 10ppm across 20 participating retail sites in the Western Cape, making one of the cleanest diesel grades available in South Africa more accessible to motorists in the province. The rollout forms part of Sasol’s ongoing commitment to providing customers with high-quality mobility solutions and helping them make informed fuel choices for their vehicles.
articles.title: Sasol brings Turbodiesel ULS 10ppm to the Western Cape
